healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Home-based care provider: private duty nursing, home health and hospice, delivered through branch offices

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Pediatric and adult home care: private duty nursing, home health, hospice, therapy (PT/OT)

patient_activity_volume.label: Patient activity / volume
patient_activity_volume.value: Serves a large base of children and adults, numbering in the tens of thousands, across many states

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Hourly/visit-based Medicaid fee-for-service for private duty nursing; Medicare per-episode payments for home health; per-diem hospice

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Network of many branch offices across a large number of U.S. states
